metadata.title: Storage Telemetry & Audit Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines how storage platforms generate authoritative, evidentiary telemetry and audit records describing data access, configuration changes, lifecycle events, and protection state, independent of application or workload narratives.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for maintaining visibility, oversight, and assurance over the security posture of institutional systems and data assets.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for evidence collection, auditability, and post-incident analysis.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Storage platforms that emit access, lifecycle, and protection telemetry.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Technologies that collect, transport, and retain telemetry and audit records.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes platform services that emit authoritative, non-repudiable telemetry for governance and security operations.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data generated to record actions, events, and changes for accountability and oversight.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data preserved to support investigations, audits, and compliance activities.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines data-centric requirements for traceability, evidentiary integrity, and visibility into data access and lifecycle events.

components.title: Storage Access Auditing
components.description: Records read, write, delete, and metadata access events with identity, object, and context attribution.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Data collection activities depend on unobserved or weakly logged access paths.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Adversaries enumerate and collect data from storage lacking access auditing.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Produces authoritative access records for investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Storage generates audit records for defined access events.
Audit records support review and analysis of storage access.
Audit logging is enabled across all storage access interfaces.

components.title: Control Plane and Configuration Logging
components.description: Logs changes to storage configuration, access policies, encryption state, retention rules, and replication settings.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Defense evasion often targets configuration and control-plane changes.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Attackers modify or disable controls to obscure malicious activity.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Detects and records changes to protection and governance settings.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Storage configuration changes are logged and reviewable.
Control-plane logs support detection of unauthorized changes.

components.title: Lifecycle and Replication Event Logging
components.description: Captures retention changes, legal hold events, replication actions, and data deletion operations.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Impact activity often attempts to delete data or bypass retention.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Data destruction and inhibition of recovery exploit weak lifecycle visibility.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Monitors and records lifecycle and retention enforcement actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Lifecycle and replication events are logged for audit.
Lifecycle logs preserve evidentiary data for incidents.

components.title: Evidence-Grade Logging and Preservation
components.description: Ensures storage audit records are tamper-evident, time-consistent, retained independently, and suitable for forensic and regulatory use.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Attackers attempt to erase or alter logs to conceal malicious actions.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Indicator and log removal undermines investigations and audits.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Preserves audit and evidentiary logs with integrity guarantees.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit logs are protected from unauthorized modification or deletion.
Audit and evidence records are retained for accountability and review.
